name: Kirge Sternhorn
summary: In the Barrens, Kirge Sternhorn guides travelers crossing central Kalimdor. The tauren keeps watch over the southern trails and sends new Horde adventurers north to the Crossroads.

sections.title: A Wayfarer in the Barrens
sections.body: New wanderers often find the sun-baked Barrens daunting. Kirge Sternhorn watches over travelers south of the central trails, between the southern camps and the heart of Kalimdor. Marauding quilboar and fierce predators roam the savanna, and Kirge helps young adventurers find their footing. He ensures they seek out the greater Horde presence gathering to the north.

faq.answer: Kirge Sternhorn is a tauren wanderer and guide in the southern Barrens. He aids Horde travelers as they cross the dusty plains.
Kirge directs travelers north to the Crossroads, the Barrens’ central junction. Horde forces coordinate defense and exploration across the region there.

faq.q: What faction does Kirge Sternhorn serve?
faq.answer: Kirge is loyal to the Horde and his fellow tauren. He offers guidance and assistance to all Horde members traveling through the territory.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see Kirge’s grounded, welcoming spirit in the way he guides fellow tribal kin and allies through the harsh frontier of their adopted homeland.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Kirge as an early waypoint from the southern reaches, pointing you toward the greater Horde community at the Crossroads.
